hints.template_name: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only. Must match your Meta template name.
hints.body_variables: Use {{1}}, {{2}}, etc. for dynamic variables. These will generate form inputs when composing.
hints.header_content: For text headers, enter the text. You can include {{1}} as an optional variable. For media headers, enter a public URL.
hints.button_url: For URL buttons, enter a static link or a dynamic URL ending in {{1}}. For phone buttons, enter the number.
hints.all_leads: Sends to every non-blocked lead with a phone number.
hints.lead_tags: Check one or more tags to include every lead with those tags, such as Cold and Warm. Leads in more than one selected tag are only sent once.
hints.all_contacts: Sends to every contact with a phone or secondary phone.
hints.all_deals: Uses the linked lead or company phone for each deal.
hints.custom_phones: Add phone numbers in international format (e.g. +1234567890).
